subject: Usage-triggered auto-topup playbook and right-size proposal
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Usage-triggered auto-topup playbook and right-size proposal

Hi Julia / Tom —

Thanks again for walking through the Q2 usage spike this morning. Attached is a concise proposal for a usage-triggered top-up workflow plus a short right-sizing playbook so BrightPath can avoid latency impact during short surge windows without committing to a large tranche upfront. High level:

- Trigger: 7-day rolling 75%+ GPU utilization on dedicated pool for 3 consecutive days.
- Action: Automatic temporary allocation of an 8-GPU burst slice (A100 equivalent) for up to 14 days OR until utilization drops below 55% for 48 hours.
- Continuity: If sustained (30+ days) we convert the burst slice to a permanent add (monthly committed GPUs) at a pre-agreed rate with pro-rated billing.

Pricing / timeline notes:
- Burst slice hourly: $X/hour (discounted 15% vs on-demand) — billed daily while active.
- Conversion: if converted to permanent within 60 days, credit for burst hours applied to first invoice.
- SLA: burst allocations are best-effort but backed by our dedicated pool policy; we include auto-fallback to a slightly lower-capacity variant (quantized model) if we cannot satisfy A100-class immediately.

I attached a short CSV with the last 60 days of utilization (BPH-usage-2028-Q2.csv) and a draft SOW that codifies the trigger/convert flow (SOW_BrightPath_April2028.pdf). Can you confirm whether BrightPath wants:

1) the automated trigger + temporary burst only, or
2) the trigger + immediate conversion to a permanent add when threshold is met, or
3) need a hybrid (auto-burst + manual approval before conversion).

If you prefer, we can set up a 30-minute call early next week to walk the legal/finance folks through the pro-rating mechanics.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachments: BPH-usage-2028-Q2.csv (summary), SOW_BrightPath_April2028.pdf (draft SOW)

From: Julia Park <julia@brightpath.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightpath.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage-triggered auto-topup playbook and right-size proposal

Thanks Vivek — this looks sensible and close to what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Can you provide a short example of how the billing will appear on our invoice (line items and credits)? We want to show finance the worst-case monthly cost if we hit two bursts in a month.
- For the conversion flow: is there an option to auto-notify our procurement Slack channel for approval (we'd prefer a 24-hour manual approval window before automatic conversion).
- SLA/latency fallback: what are the expected 95th percentile latencies for the quantized fallback model vs the full A100 path (we have a customer-facing SLA to meet).

Tom and I are generally aligned on option (3) — auto-burst + manual conversion within 24 hours. If you can send the invoice example and a one-pager on latency deltas I can route to procurement.

Best,
Julia

--
Julia Park
Head of Platform, BrightPath Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Usage-triggered auto-topup playbook and right-size proposal

Vivek — forwarding Julia's note. Procurement will want a clear invoice mock and a short 24-hour approval API option. I've sketched options below for finance review:

> On Fri, May 17, 2028 at 11:03 AM Julia Park <julia@brightpath.ai> wrote:
> > Thanks Vivek — this looks sensible...

Finance / Pricing suggestions (draft):
- Create a single invoice line item: "Burst capacity (BPH-6821)" with two sub-lines: hours consumed (at burst rate) and conversion credit applied (if converted within 60 days).
- Example invoice (worst-case): two bursts = 2 x 14 days x 24 hrs x 8 GPUs x $X/hr = $Y (we need to compute with current X).
- Offer a soft cap toggle for the customer UI: they can set a monthly burst budget to avoid surprises, with notifications at 50%/80%/95%.

Operational notes:
- Ben — can infra/ops confirm we can surface a Slack auto-notify + 24-hr approve endpoint in the API? If not, what is the minimal viable manual flow?
- Neha — legal will want to tweak the SOW language on conversion credits and SLA fallback — can you look at SOW_BrightPath_April2028.pdf and propose language?

Thanks — if we can respond Monday with an invoice mock and a short API doc for the approval flow, we can get procurement moving.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@brightpath.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage-triggered auto-topup playbook and right-size proposal

Julia / Tom —

Appreciate the quick read. Summary of agreed next steps:

1) We will implement option (3): auto-burst when trigger met + 24-hour manual conversion approval. If no approval in 24 hours conversion is paused and legal will route for a single-touch exec approval.
2) Finance will send an invoice mock (see attached mock URL) with worst-case two-burst example and an implementation of the conversion credit.
3) Ops will expose a Slack webhook + "/redwood approve-burst <deal>" endpoint for procurement control; until the API is live Ops will send a triage email to procurement SREs.
4) Legal (Neha) will redline the SOW; we'll circulate a DocuSign link for signature once redlines are resolved.

Links and attachments:
- Invoice mock: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-invoice-mock
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=abc123-docusign-BPH6821
- Attached: SOW_BrightPath_April2028.pdf (updated with conversion clause) and the utilization CSV we referenced.

Julia — if that matches your expectations we'll generate the DocuSign envelope and schedule the 30-minute procurement walk-through on Monday.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
